questions.explanation: 根据后半句“sharing food and laughter（分享食物和欢笑）”可知，邻居们非常热心肠，关系融洽。optimistic（乐观的）、coldhearted（冷酷的）、pessimistic（悲观的）均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(optimistic)：a) She is optimistic about her chances of winning the competition. b) be optimistic about, remain optimistic
B(warmhearted)：a) The warmhearted villagers offered the lost travelers food and shelter. b) a warmhearted person, warmhearted support
C(coldhearted)：a) It was coldhearted of him to ignore the beggar's plea for help. b) a coldhearted killer, a coldhearted decision
D(pessimistic)：a) He has a pessimistic view of the company's future. b) be pessimistic about, a pessimistic outlook

questions.explanation: 前文提到在开普敦和邻居分享食物和欢笑，当他搬到美国时，这些美好的“记忆”留存在他心中。challenges（挑战）、stories（故事，不如记忆贴切）、duties（责任）不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(memories)：a) The photo album brought back many fond memories of her childhood. b) fond memories, bring back memories
B(challenges)：a) We must face the environmental challenges of the 21st century. b) meet a challenge, face challenges
C(stories)：a) My grandfather used to tell me bedtime stories every night. b) tell stories, a true story
D(duties)：a) It is the duty of every citizen to obey the law. b) perform one's duties, a sense of duty

questions.explanation: Clement和妻子最终在纽约上州“定居”（settled）。benefit（受益）、lecture（演讲/说教）、fix（修理/固定）均不符合定居的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(benefited)：a) The local economy has benefited greatly from tourism. b) benefit from, be of benefit to
B(lectured)：a) The professor lectured on modern history for two hours. b) lecture on, give a lecture
C(fixed)：a) He finally fixed the broken washing machine yesterday. b) fix a problem, fix a date
D(settled)：a) After years of traveling, they eventually settled in a quiet village. b) settle in, settle down

questions.explanation: 前半句说“街上住满了家庭，院子也相连”，后半句说“邻居之间却有一种明显的距离感”，前后构成让步/转折关系，故选Although（尽管）。
questions.supplement:
A(As)：a) As it was raining heavily, we decided to stay indoors. b) as well as, as long as
B(If)：a) If you study hard, you will definitely pass the exam. b) if only, what if
C(Since)：a) Since everyone is here, let's start the meeting. b) ever since, long since
D(Although)：a) Although he was exhausted, he continued working on the project. b) although it is true, although small

questions.explanation: 邻居间有着明显的距离感，就好像有一堵“无形的”（invisible）墙将他们隔开。unreliable（不可靠的）、special（特别的）、meaningful（有意义的）不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(unreliable)：a) The bus service in this area is notoriously unreliable. b) an unreliable narrator, highly unreliable
B(special)：a) This necklace is very special to me because it was a gift from my mother. b) special attention, special needs
C(invisible)：a) The bacteria are invisible to the naked eye. b) an invisible wall, invisible to
D(meaningful)：a) She wants to do meaningful work that helps the community. b) a meaningful conversation, meaningful connections

questions.explanation: 受到一本书的启发，Clement决定为邻居们“举办”（host）一场欢迎派对。attend（参加）不符合主语发起的动作，indicate（表明）、enjoy（享受）不搭配party的筹办。
questions.supplement:
A(indicate)：a) Research indicates that eating healthy food can extend your lifespan. b) indicate that, clearly indicate
B(host)：a) Our school will host the annual sports meet next month. b) host a party, host an event
C(enjoy)：a) We hope you enjoy your stay at our hotel. b) enjoy doing sth, thoroughly enjoy
D(attend)：a) All students are required to attend the lecture. b) attend a meeting, attend to (处理/照料)

questions.explanation: 他准备了派对，希望邻居们能“顺便拜访/过来串门”（drop by）。go back（回去）、pick up（捡起/接人）、come across（偶遇）均不符合派对邀请语境。
questions.supplement:
A(go back)：a) I can never go back to the way things were before. b) go back to, go back on one's word
B(pick up)：a) Could you pick up some milk on your way home? b) pick up a habit, pick up the phone
C(drop by)：a) Feel free to drop by my office if you have any questions. b) drop by for a chat, drop by someone's house
D(come across)：a) I came across an old friend while walking in the park. b) come across as, come across an issue

questions.explanation: 随着时间流逝，加上后面的疑问“要是没人来怎么办？”，可知他感到“焦虑的”（anxious）。proud（自豪的）、excited（兴奋的）、relieved（松了一口气的）均与担忧的心情相悖。
questions.supplement:
A(anxious)：a) She felt extremely anxious before the final job interview. b) be anxious about, be anxious to do
B(proud)：a) His parents are very proud of his academic achievements. b) be proud of, take pride in
C(excited)：a) The children were excited about the upcoming field trip. b) be excited about, be excited to see
D(relieved)：a) I was relieved to hear that everyone survived the accident. b) feel relieved, be relieved to know

questions.explanation: 当他准备放弃时，他的女儿们“加入”了他，一起等待客人的到来。join sb in doing sth（加入某人做某事）是固定搭配。assist（协助）用于此处略显生硬，instruct（指导）、engage（从事）不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(instructed)：a) The teacher instructed the students to hand in their papers. b) instruct sb to do sth, be instructed to
B(engaged)：a) The company is engaged in developing new software. b) be engaged in, engage with
C(assisted)：a) The nurse assisted the doctor in performing the operation. b) assist sb with sth, assist in doing
D(joined)：a) He joined us in celebrating the team's victory. b) join sb in doing sth, join in

questions.explanation: 下午6:10，一对推着婴儿车的夫妇“走近”（approached），即来到了派对现场。register（登记）、change（改变）、adapt（适应）均不符合客人到来的动作。
questions.supplement:
A(registered)：a) Have you registered for the online training course yet? b) register for, register a trademark
B(approached)：a) As winter approached, the days started getting shorter. b) approach a problem, approach sb for sth
C(changed)：a) He changed his mind after hearing the persuasive argument. b) change completely, change for the better
D(adapted)：a) The animals have adapted to the harsh desert environment. b) adapt to, adapt sth for sth

questions.explanation: 继第一对夫妇到来让Clement心情好转后，“最终/渐渐地”（Eventually），更多的邻居也跟着来了。Surprisingly（令人惊讶地）、Obviously（明显地）、Hopefully（有希望地）不如Eventually能体现时间推移中客人陆续到来的过程感。
questions.supplement:
A(Surprisingly)：a) Surprisingly, the test was much easier than we had anticipated. b) not surprisingly, somewhat surprisingly
B(Obviously)：a) Obviously, she was not happy with the test results. b) state the obvious, quite obviously
C(Eventually)：a) After a long journey, they eventually reached the top of the mountain. b) eventually become, eventually lead to
D(Hopefully)：a) Hopefully, the weather will clear up by tomorrow morning. b) wait hopefully, smile hopefully

questions.explanation: 到了晚上结束时来了二十个人，整个“氛围”（atmosphere）充满了温暖和连接感。decoration（装饰）、treat（款待）、experience（经历）不能被填满（filled with）“温暖和连接感”。
questions.supplement:
A(atmosphere)：a) The restaurant has a cozy and romantic atmosphere. b) a relaxed atmosphere, create an atmosphere
B(decoration)：a) We bought some beautiful decoration for the Christmas tree. b) interior decoration, festive decoration
C(treat)：a) As a special treat, I'll take you out for ice cream. b) a rare treat, treat sb to sth
D(experience)：a) Traveling abroad is an eye-opening experience for young people. b) gain experience, have experience in

questions.explanation: Clement意识到每个人内心其实一直都在渴望这种“社区/共同体”（community）归属感。呼应全文主题。participation（参与）、trend（趋势）、application（应用）不契合文章立意。
questions.supplement:
A(participation)：a) Active participation in class discussions is encouraged by the teacher. b) encourage participation, active participation
B(trend)：a) Working from home has become a growing trend in recent years. b) follow a trend, a general trend
C(application)：a) The deadline for the job application is next Friday. b) practical application, an application form
D(community)：a) The new center will serve the needs of the local community. b) local community, community service

questions.explanation: 派对取得了“成功”（success），所以Clement建了一个群来组织未来的聚会。celebration（庆祝）、desire（渴望）、chance（机会）不符合对整场派对结果的评价。
questions.supplement:
A(celebration)：a) We had a huge celebration for my grandfather's 80th birthday. b) hold a celebration, in celebration of
B(success)：a) The charity event was a great success, raising thousands of dollars. b) a great success, achieve success
C(desire)：a) He has a strong desire to travel around the world. b) a strong desire, have no desire to
D(chance)：a) You should grab this rare chance to study abroad. b) by chance, take a chance

questions.explanation: 社区不仅仅是一个“物理上的”（physical）地方，而是人们愿意迈出第一步去爱邻居的归属地。与后半句的人际情感连接形成对比。typical（典型的）、identical（相同的）、mental（精神的）均不符合此处的对比逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(typical)：a) It was a typical English summer day, with sudden rain showers. b) a typical example, it is typical of sb
B(identical)：a) The two sisters wore identical dresses to the party. b) be identical to, identical twins
C(physical)：a) Regular physical exercise is good for your overall health. b) physical health, a physical place
D(mental)：a) Stress can have a negative impact on a person's mental health. b) mental health, mental illness

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go and live in a different place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，表示过去发生的移居行为。
vocab_pack.example_en: After graduation, he decided to move to a big city for better opportunities.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 毕业后，他决定搬到大城市寻找更好的机会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Clement Sprout moved to Upstate New York

vocab_pack.definition_en: to spend one's childhood; to develop into an adult
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，表示他在南非长大的经历。
vocab_pack.example_en: She grew up in a small village surrounded by mountains.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在一个被群山环绕的小村庄长大。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He grew up in Cape Town

vocab_pack.definition_en: kind, friendly, and sympathetic
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，在句中作表语（were warmhearted），描述邻居的性格。
vocab_pack.example_en: The warmhearted teacher often helps students with personal problems.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位热心的老师经常帮助学生解决个人问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: neighbors were warmhearted

vocab_pack.definition_en: to enjoy meals and happy moments together
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作伴随状语，表示邻居们同时进行的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: During the festival, families share food and laughter with each other.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 节日期间，家人们互相分享食物和欢笑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: neighbors were warmhearted, sharing food and laughter

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remain in one's memory or mind
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，表示这些记忆一直留在他心中。
vocab_pack.example_en: The beautiful scenery stayed with me long after the trip.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旅途结束后，美丽的风景久久留在我心中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: These memories stayed with him

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become established in a new home or environment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，表示他们最终在纽约州北部定居。
vocab_pack.example_en: After a few weeks, the new students began to settle in.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 几周后，新生们开始适应新环境。
vocab_pack.from_passage: They eventually settled in Upstate New York

vocab_pack.definition_en: to imagine or hope for something desired
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作伴随状语，表示他们定居时的愿望。
vocab_pack.example_en: She always dreams of traveling around the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她一直梦想着周游世界。
vocab_pack.from_passage: dreaming of a close-knit neighborhood

vocab_pack.definition_en: closely united or connected, especially of a community
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 紧密团结的，关系紧密的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语修饰neighborhood。
vocab_pack.example_en: They live in a close-knit community where everyone knows each other.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们住在一个关系紧密的社区，每个人都互相认识。
vocab_pack.from_passage: dreaming of a close-knit neighborhood

vocab_pack.definition_en: to purchase a home
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，表示2020年他们买了房子。
vocab_pack.example_en: They plan to buy a house near the city center.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们计划在市中心附近买一栋房子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Clement and Sarah bought a house on Whitney Drive

vocab_pack.definition_en: containing a large amount of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语作表语，描述街道上有很多家庭。
vocab_pack.example_en: The park is full of children playing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公园里充满了玩耍的孩子们。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Although the street was full of families

vocab_pack.definition_en: to connect with each other
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态过去式（were interconnected），interconnected为过去分词作表语，表示庭院相互连通。
vocab_pack.example_en: The various parts of the system are interconnected.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 系统的各个部分相互连接。
vocab_pack.from_passage: yards were interconnected

vocab_pack.definition_en: a feeling of emotional or social separation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作动词was的宾语，表示存在一种明显的疏离感。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new student felt a sense of distance from his classmates.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新生感到与同学之间有一种距离感。
vocab_pack.from_passage: there was a distinct sense of distance

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: as if a(n) invisible wall had separated them
vocab_pack.definition_en: in a way that suggests something is true
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 引导方式状语从句，从句使用过去完成时（had separated）表示与过去事实相反的虚拟语气。
vocab_pack.example_en: He looked at me as if he had never seen me before.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他看着我，好像从未见过我似的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as if a(n) invisible wall had separated them

vocab_pack.definition_en: unable to be seen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语修饰wall，表示无形的墙。
vocab_pack.example_en: The wind is invisible, but we can feel it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 风是看不见的，但我们可以感觉到它。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a(n) invisible wall

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause to move or be apart
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去完成时（had separated），表示在过去的某个时间点之前已经发生的动作，用于as if从句中。
vocab_pack.example_en: The war separated many families.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 战争使许多家庭分离。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as if a(n) invisible wall had separated them

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give someone the desire, confidence, or enthusiasm to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作状语，表示Clement受到一本书的鼓舞（被动含义）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher's words inspired her to work harder.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师的话激励她更加努力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Inspired by a book on building strong neighborhoods

vocab_pack.definition_en: a party held to welcome someone to a new place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作动词 host 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: They organized a welcome party for the new exchange students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们为新的交换生组织了一个欢迎聚会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: host a welcome party for the neighbors

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get everything ready for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，made为make的过去式，表示他做了充分的准备。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team made preparations for the final exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 团队为期末考试做了准备。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Clement made full preparations for the party

vocab_pack.definition_en: to visit someone informally, often without notice
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为动词原形，用于would后（would drop by），表示过去的习惯或希望。
vocab_pack.example_en: Feel free to drop by my office anytime.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 随时欢迎来我办公室坐坐。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He hoped neighbors would drop by

vocab_pack.definition_en: (of time) to pass gradually
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，表示时间一分一秒地过去。
vocab_pack.example_en: The minutes ticked by as we waited for the bus.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们等公交车时，时间一分一秒地过去。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as the minutes ticked by

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: on the point of giving up
vocab_pack.definition_en: about to do something; just at the moment of doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作表语，后接动名词，表示即将放弃的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was on the point of leaving when the phone rang.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她正要离开时电话响了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: When he was on the point of giving up

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stop trying; to abandon
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词形式，作介词of的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Never give up on your dreams.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 永远不要放弃你的梦想。
vocab_pack.from_passage: on the point of giving up

vocab_pack.definition_en: to participate with someone in an activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，joined为过去式，后接宾语him，再接介词in+动名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: I will join you in celebrating your birthday.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我会和你一起庆祝生日。
vocab_pack.from_passage: his daughters, Olivia and Holly, joined him in waiting for guests

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come near or nearer to someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，表示一对夫妇推着婴儿车走近。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dog approached the stranger cautiously.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 狗小心翼翼地靠近陌生人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a couple pushing a baby carriage approached

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make someone feel happier or more hopeful
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，主语是Clement's heart，表示他的心情变好（heart lifted 意为心情振奋）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The good news lifted her spirits.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个好消息让她精神振奋。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Clement's heart lifted

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: by the end of the evening
vocab_pack.definition_en: before or at the time when something finishes
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作时间状语，表示在晚会结束时之前。
vocab_pack.example_en: By the end of the year, he had saved enough money.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 到年底时，他已经存了足够的钱。
vocab_pack.from_passage: By the end of the evening, twenty people came.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to desire something strongly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中用于过去完成进行时（had been longing for），表示从过去某个时间一直持续到过去的另一个时间的渴望。
vocab_pack.example_en: After years abroad, she longed for her hometown.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在国外多年后，她渴望回到家乡。
vocab_pack.from_passage: everyone had been longing for this kind of community

vocab_pack.definition_en: to initiate the first action in a process
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语，在句中与to take并列（省略to），表示愿意采取第一步。
vocab_pack.example_en: It takes courage to take the first step toward change.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 迈出改变的第一步需要勇气。
vocab_pack.from_passage: people are willing to take the first step

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have affection for the people living nearby
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词原形，与take并列的不定式（省略to），表示愿意爱邻居。
vocab_pack.example_en: The community encourages everyone to love their neighbors.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 社区鼓励每个人爱自己的邻居。
vocab_pack.from_passage: willing to take the first step and love their neighbors

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: not a physical place, but somewhere
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to contrast two things, emphasizing the second
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 并列结构，连接两个表语，表示否定前者肯定后者。
vocab_pack.example_en: Success is not about luck, but about hard work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 成功不在于运气，而在于努力工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a community is not a physical place, but somewhere where people are willing to take the first step

section_2_word_form.passage:
Visual artists from around the world explored the beauty and [56] of Guizhou province in Southwest China during the five-day Visual @ China Guizhou 2024 trip.

This charming national park, included on [62] list of UNESCO World Heritage Sites, is known for its unique karst(喀斯特) landscapes and various water [63].

Through their lenses and brushes, the artists enable the beauty of Guizhou, with its lush landscapes and vibrant ethnic culture, to be seen by a larger audience in the world, [65] a more authentic, multidimensional, and comprehensive image of China.

questions.explanation: 设空处与前面的名词 beauty 并列，由 and 连接，共同作 explored 的宾语，故需将形容词 unique 变为名词 uniqueness（独特，独特性）。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(uniqueness)：语境句：The uniqueness of this design lies in its simplicity. 固定搭配：the uniqueness of, value uniqueness。原词unique其它变形：uniquely(adv.)。

questions.explanation: 本句缺少谓语动词，主语 Benjamin Thomas Kirchner 与 fascinate 之间是动宾关系（被迷住），且事情发生在过去，故使用一般过去时或过去完成时的被动语态。Ahead of his first trip 提示这种着迷的状态在来中国之前就存在，故用 had been fascinated 更为严谨，was fascinated 亦可接受。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(was/had been fascinated)：语境句：He was completely fascinated by the traditional Chinese paper-cutting art. 固定搭配：be fascinated by/with, endlessly fascinated。原词fascinate其它变形：fascinating(adj. 迷人的), fascination(n. 魅力/着迷)。

questions.explanation: 设空处作后置定语，修饰前面的 landscape and architecture。由于 landscape and architecture 与 present（呈现）之间是被动关系（被展现在古画卷中），故填入过去分词 presented。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(presented)：语境句：The data presented in the report shows a significant increase in sales. 固定搭配：be presented with, the information presented。原词present其它变形：presentation(n.), presently(adv.)。

questions.explanation: 设空处修饰形容词 stimulating，需要用副词形式，故将 incredible 变为 incredibly（极度地，难以置信地）。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(incredibly)：语境句：The movie was incredibly moving, making many people cry. 固定搭配：incredibly difficult, incredibly important。原词incredible其它变形：credibility(n.), credible(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 时间状语 over the centuries（几个世纪以来）通常与现在完成时连用。主语 their dialect, clothes, diet and customs 是复数，故填 have changed。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(have changed)：语境句：Our living conditions have changed greatly over the past few decades. 固定搭配：have changed over time, have changed significantly。原词change其它变形：changeable(adj.), unchanged(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 固定搭配 be impressed by/with 意为“对……印象深刻”。Kirchner对小七孔风景区印象深刻。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(by/with)：语境句：The interviewers were highly impressed by her fluent English. 固定搭配：be impressed by, be impressed with。

questions.explanation: 此处特指“联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录”，被 of UNESCO World Heritage Sites 修饰，名词 list 前需加定冠词 the，构成 included on the list of (被列入……的名录)。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(the)：语境句：The Great Wall was added to the list of World Heritage Sites in 1987. 固定搭配：on the list of, make the list。

questions.explanation: feature 作可数名词意为“特征，特色，风貌”。前面有 various（各种各样的）修饰，故应用复数形式 features。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(features)：语境句：The latest smartphone boasts several innovative new features. 固定搭配：water features, unique features。原词feature其它变形：featureless(adj.), featuring(v. 现在分词)。

questions.explanation: 介词 on 后接宾语从句，从句中 they have seen and experienced 缺少宾语，意为“所看到和经历的事情”，故填关系代词 what。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(what)：语境句：He couldn't fully express what he felt at that moment. 固定搭配：based on what, what matters most。

questions.explanation: 本句已有谓语动词 enable，且其后没有连词，故此处需用非谓语动词。艺术家们使贵州的美景被世界看到，这一行为自然而然地产生了“推广更真实中国形象”的结果。动词 promote 与主语 the artists（或者前面整件事）构成主动关系，故用现在分词 promoting 作伴随状语或结果状语。
questions.supplement: 正确词形(promoting)：语境句：The campaign aims to raise environmental awareness, promoting sustainable living. 固定搭配：promoting economic growth, an active role in promoting。原词promote其它变形：promotion(n.), promoter(n.)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: in front of; before (in time)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作状语，表示时间上早于某事件。原文中大写首字母，位于句首。
vocab_pack.example_en: Finish your homework ahead of the deadline.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在截止日期前完成你的作业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Ahead of his first trip to China

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: was fascinated / had been fascinated by
vocab_pack.definition_en: be extremely interested or attracted by something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态结构，be动词根据时态和主语变化。原文用了was（一般过去时被动）和had been（过去完成时被动），表示被吸引的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was fascinated by the ancient architecture during her trip.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在旅行中被古老的建筑深深吸引。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was fascinated / had been fascinated by the magical, fairytale-like beauty

vocab_pack.definition_en: immediately after doing something; when doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词upon后接动名词，表示动作一发生就紧接着另一个动作。原文中大写首字母。
vocab_pack.example_en: Upon arriving at the airport, she called her parents.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一到机场，她就给父母打了电话。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Upon visiting Yunshantun village in Anshun, Guizhou

vocab_pack.definition_en: personally; by seeing directly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语作状语，his与主语一致，表示亲眼所见。
vocab_pack.example_en: I want to see the Great Wall with my own eyes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我想亲眼看看长城。
vocab_pack.from_passage: seeing the scenery with his own eyes

vocab_pack.definition_en: encouraging new ideas or enthusiasm; exciting
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，在句中与inspiring并列作表语，描述看到风景后的感受。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher's words were stimulating to the students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师的话激励了学生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was incredibly stimulating and inspiring

vocab_pack.definition_en: causing people to feel enthusiastic and want to do something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 鼓舞人心的；启发灵感的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，与stimulating并列作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: His speech was inspiring to the audience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的演讲鼓舞了听众。
vocab_pack.from_passage: stimulating and inspiring

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who is a relative of someone who lived in the past
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 可数名词，原文复数形式作表语，表示村民是士兵的后代。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is a descendant of a famous general.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他是一位著名将军的后裔。
vocab_pack.from_passage: are descendants of soldiers

vocab_pack.definition_en: make certain that something will happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词原形，在不定式to ensure中作目的状语，表示“为了确保”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must take steps to ensure the safety of all passengers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须采取措施确保所有乘客的安全。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to ensure regional peace

vocab_pack.definition_en: hardly change at all; remain almost the same
vocab_pack.grammar_note: change + 副词little，表示程度小。原文为现在完成时，主语复数，所以用have changed little。
vocab_pack.example_en: The local traditions have changed little over the years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当地的传统多年来变化很小。
vocab_pack.from_passage: have changed little over the centuries

vocab_pack.definition_en: feel admiration and respect for someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动结构，be impressed by/with均可。原文一般过去时被动，by和with并列给出。
vocab_pack.example_en: I was deeply impressed by her performance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我对她的表演印象非常深刻。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was also impressed by / with the Xiaoqikong Scenic Area

vocab_pack.definition_en: an area of natural beauty designated for tourists
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 专有名词的一部分，指具体景区名称，首字母大写。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Yellow Mountain is a famous scenic area in China.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 黄山是中国著名的风景区。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the Xiaoqikong Scenic Area

vocab_pack.definition_en: be famous for; be recognized because of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动结构，be known for用于描述特点。原文一般现在时，主语单数。
vocab_pack.example_en: Hangzhou is known for its beautiful West Lake.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 杭州因其美丽的西湖而闻名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: is known for its unique karst landscapes

vocab_pack.definition_en: being the only one of its kind; very special
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，修饰karst landscapes，作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Each person has a unique fingerprint.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个人都有独特的指纹。
vocab_pack.from_passage: unique karst landscapes

vocab_pack.definition_en: a landscape formed by the dissolution of soluble rocks, characterized by caves and sinkholes
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，原文复数形式，与water features并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: Guilin is famous for its karst landscapes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 桂林以其喀斯特地貌闻名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: karst landscapes

vocab_pack.definition_en: elements of landscape design involving water, such as lakes, streams, fountains
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，与karst landscapes并列，作介词for的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The park has many beautiful water features.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个公园有许多美丽的水景。
vocab_pack.from_passage: various water features

vocab_pack.definition_en: use something as the foundation for something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作状语，based on表示“根据…”，原文中大写首字母位于句首。
vocab_pack.example_en: The movie is based on a true story.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部电影基于真实故事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Based on what they have seen and experienced

vocab_pack.definition_en: a number of similar things happening one after another
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语，后接可数名词复数，表示多个。
vocab_pack.example_en: He gave a series of lectures on environmental protection.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他就环境保护做了一系列讲座。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a series of artistic works

vocab_pack.definition_en: works of art, such as paintings, sculptures, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，复数形式，作creating的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum displays many artistic works from different periods.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆展出了许多不同时期的艺术作品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: artistic works

vocab_pack.definition_en: show or express a particular quality or idea
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词原形，在定语从句中作谓语，主语which指代artistic works，一般现在时。
vocab_pack.example_en: His paintings reflect his inner emotions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的画作反映了他内心的情感。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which reflect their individual styles

vocab_pack.definition_en: personal and distinctive ways of creating art
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作reflect的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Every artist has his or her own individual style.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个艺术家都有自己独特的个人风格。
vocab_pack.from_passage: their individual styles

vocab_pack.definition_en: a curved piece of glass that focuses light; here, a camera lens
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 可数名词，原文复数形式，与brushes并列，通过他们的镜头（相机）和画笔。
vocab_pack.example_en: The photographer cleaned his lenses before shooting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 摄影师在拍摄前清洁了镜头。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Through their lenses and brushes

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: enable the beauty of Guizhou...to be seen
vocab_pack.definition_en: make it possible for someone or something to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: enable + 宾语 + 不定式，原文中宾语为the beauty of Guizhou，不定式为被动形式to be seen。
vocab_pack.example_en: The scholarship enabled him to study abroad.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 奖学金使他能够出国留学。
vocab_pack.from_passage: enable the beauty of Guizhou…to be seen by a larger audience

vocab_pack.definition_en: (of vegetation) growing thickly and healthily
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，修饰landscapes，作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The lush green forest is home to many animals.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 茂密的绿色森林是许多动物的家园。
vocab_pack.from_passage: lush landscapes

vocab_pack.definition_en: full of energy and life; bright and strong in color
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，修饰ethnic culture，作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The city has a vibrant nightlife.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市有充满活力的夜生活。
vocab_pack.from_passage: vibrant ethnic culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: support or encourage the development of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词，在句中作伴随状语，表示同时发生的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The campaign aims to promote healthy eating habits.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这项运动旨在推广健康的饮食习惯。
vocab_pack.from_passage: promoting a more authentic, multidimensional, and comprehensive image

vocab_pack.definition_en: real and genuine; not false or copied
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，修饰image，与multidimensional, comprehensive并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to provide authentic information.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要提供真实的信息。
vocab_pack.from_passage: authentic, multidimensional, and comprehensive image

vocab_pack.definition_en: having many different aspects or dimensions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，与authentic, comprehensive并列修饰image。
vocab_pack.example_en: The problem requires a multidimensional approach.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个问题需要多维度的解决方法。
vocab_pack.from_passage: multidimensional

vocab_pack.definition_en: including all or most things; thorough
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，修饰image，与authentic, multidimensional并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: The report provides a comprehensive analysis.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 报告提供了全面的分析。
vocab_pack.from_passage: comprehensive image

vocab_pack.definition_en: resembling a fairy tale; magical and beautiful
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词，由fairytale加-like构成，修饰beauty，作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The old castle had a fairytale-like appearance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座古堡有童话般的外观。
vocab_pack.from_passage: fairytale-like beauty

vocab_pack.definition_en: show or display something; introduce
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词作后置定语，修饰landscape and architecture，表示“被呈现在…中”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The exhibit presents a collection of ancient artifacts.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 展览展示了一批古代文物。
vocab_pack.from_passage: presented in ancient scrolls…and modern films
